DeviceCaptureStorage

@memory_only
struct DeviceCaptureStorage[captures: Captures[captures.Specs]]

Owns uploaded capture values until execution and copy-back finish.

Parameters

  • captures (Captures[captures.Specs]): The kernel’s declared capture slots.

Implemented traits

AnyType, Deinitable, Movable

Methods

Expand all   Collapse all

__init__

Creates empty capture ownership without queueing work.

def __init__(out self)

Args:

  • self (Self)

Returns:

Self

prepare

Uploads each bound host value into its own device allocation.

def prepare(mut self, device: DeviceContext, host: CaptureAccessor[captures], mut frame: _TransferFrame)

Args:

  • self (Self)
  • device (DeviceContext): The device queue used for the kernel invocation.
  • host (CaptureAccessor[captures]): Addresses of the borrowed host-local values.
  • frame (_TransferFrame): Native staging owner for synchronous execution.

Raises:

Error: If allocating or uploading a capture fails.

Constraints:

Device captures must be trivially copyable and trivially deletable. Values must not contain pointers to host-only memory.

copy_back

Queues downloads of mutable captures to their original host locals.

def copy_back(self, host: CaptureAccessor[captures], mut frame: _TransferFrame)

Args:

  • self (Self)
  • host (CaptureAccessor[captures]): Addresses retained by the invocation’s host bindings.
  • frame (_TransferFrame): Stages downloads for publication after synchronization.

Raises:

Error: If enqueueing a download fails.
